domain_of_validity.excluded: the COMPANION support-scaling clause Delta S_pose ~= 0.0024*f^1.16*tau^2, whose support arm is only 4 seeded-random pairs -- deliberately NOT registered until widened to n>=120 (ddm_rbf1's own precondition); and any COUNTED edit, which pays bytes this law does not price
domain_of_validity.operating_point_dependence: the 6.6e-03 coefficient is 5/sqrt(10*d_pose) = 738 times k at d_pose 4.59e-06; re-derive the coefficient at any other operating point
domain_of_validity.support: n = 24 seeded-random pairs (seed 1), ~22,000 pixels, tau in {1,2,4,8} plus a -8 sign control. NOT n600. The arm's n600 rows are the mode-composition closure, a different population
